services.name: Parasailing - Slidell
services.desc: Sail over the water with us! Duration 1 Hour Parasailing trips last approximately 1 hour roundtrip if 12 people are on board. About Parasail Adventures offers exhilarating parasailing experiences over the water. Passengers can soar up to 400 feet in the air, enjoying panoramic views while experiencing the thrill of takeoff and a gentle descent. The 31-foot vessel accommodates up to 12 passengers, allowing groups to share the adventure. 2 or 3 people can parasail at once so bring your thrill-seeking friends for an unforgettable adventure over the largest inland body of water in Louisiana, Lake Pontchartrain! Meet at The Pointe Marina of Slidell just a 30 minute drive from New Orleans.

services.name: Parasail Adventures
services.desc: We warmly invite you to embark on an exhilarating parasailing adventure with us, where you’ll have the opportunity to soak in breathtaking views of the sparkling waters from hundreds of feet above. As you soar gracefully through the sky, securely seated in a comfortable harness attached to a vibrant parachute, you’ll experience the thrill of flight combined with the serene beauty of nature below. Join us for an unforgettable experience that promises to elevate your spirit and create lasting memories! We look forward to welcoming you aboard! Book your experience online and join us at J Pier, conveniently nestled between the vibrant Margaritaville Resort and the iconic Golden Nugget Casino.
